manage-shifts.title: Manage scheduled shifts for team members
manage-shifts.summary: Learn how to use advanced scheduling to create manageable team shifts.
manage-shifts.body:
Open Team > Scheduled shifts to see every team member's week. Click a day to edit just that day, or choose Set repeating shifts to build a weekly pattern.

Online bookings only land inside scheduled shifts, so keep them up to date when someone changes their hours.

patch-tests.title: Record client patch tests
patch-tests.summary: Incorporating patch tests for certain services to detect potential allergies.
patch-tests.body:
Mark a service as needing a patch test in the service settings. When you book it, the calendar warns you if the client has no valid test.

Record results from the client profile so the whole team can see them.

blast-campaigns.title: Create email Blast campaigns
blast-campaigns.summary: Craft and launch effective email campaigns that drive client engagement and boost sales.
blast-campaigns.body:
Go to Marketing > Blast campaigns and create a campaign. Pick an audience or segment, write your message and send it now or schedule it.

Track opens, clicks and bookings from the campaign once it is sent.

smart-pricing.title: Enable Smart pricing
smart-pricing.summary: Set up Smart pricing to automatically increase and decrease during busy or quiet periods.
smart-pricing.body: Smart pricing adjusts online prices by time of day. Choose the services and team members it applies to, then add increases for busy hours and discounts for quiet ones.

add-team-members.title: Add team members to your workspace
add-team-members.summary: Onboard new team members by setting them up with a profile in your workspace.
add-team-members.body: Go to Team > Team members and click Add. Enter their details, services, locations and permission level, then send an invite so they can log in.

create-appointment.title: Create and edit appointments in the calendar
create-appointment.summary: Book, move and repeat appointments from the calendar.
create-appointment.body: Click an empty slot or use Add > Appointment. Choose the client, services and time. Drag a booking to reschedule it or drag its bottom edge to change the duration.

checkout-sale.title: Check out an appointment and take payment
checkout-sale.summary: Take payment, add tips and send receipts.
checkout-sale.body: Open the appointment and click Checkout. Add products or discounts, choose a tip, then pick a payment method. The receipt can be emailed or texted to the client.

refunds.title: Refund or void a sale
refunds.summary: Return money to a client or cancel a sale that was made by mistake.
refunds.body: Open the sale and choose Refund to return items or an amount. Void cancels an unpaid sale. Refunds show in Sales and Reports straight away.

online-booking.title: Turn on online bookings and the Book now link
online-booking.summary: Let clients book from your website and social pages.
online-booking.body: Use Online presence > Link builder to create a Book now link or button. Add it to your website, Instagram or Facebook and bookings appear in your calendar.

marketplace-profile.title: Set up your marketplace profile
marketplace-profile.summary: Get discovered by new clients on the marketplace.
marketplace-profile.body: Complete your profile with photos, a description, amenities and opening hours. Listed locations can receive bookings from the marketplace.

deposits-policy.title: Take deposits and set cancellation fees
deposits-policy.summary: Protect your time with deposits, late cancellation and no-show fees.
deposits-policy.body: In Settings > Payments > Payment policy, turn on deposits and choose your cancellation window. Fees are charged automatically when a client cancels late or does not show up.

gift-cards.title: Sell and redeem gift cards
gift-cards.summary: Sell gift cards in person or online and redeem them at checkout.
gift-cards.body: Sell a gift card from checkout or let clients buy one online. At checkout choose Redeem gift card and enter the code to pay with its balance.

packages-memberships.title: Sell packages and memberships
packages-memberships.summary: Bundle sessions or bill clients every month.
packages-memberships.body: Create packages and memberships in the Catalog. Sell them at checkout; sessions are deducted automatically when the client books covered services.

import-clients.title: Import your client list from a CSV file
import-clients.summary: Move your clients from another system in minutes.
import-clients.body: Go to Clients list > Options > Import clients. Download the template, fill it in and upload it. Duplicates are detected before the import finishes.

client-segments.title: Group clients with segments
client-segments.summary: Find loyal, lapsed or new clients automatically.
client-segments.body: Segments update themselves from client activity. Use them to filter your client list or as the audience of a campaign.

automations-reminders.title: Set up automated reminders and confirmations
automations-reminders.summary: Send confirmations and reminders without lifting a finger.
automations-reminders.body: Marketing > Automations lists every automatic message. Turn each one on or off and choose email, SMS or WhatsApp. Sent messages appear in Messages history.

products-stock.title: Track product stock, stocktakes and stock orders
products-stock.summary: Keep shelves full and know what you sell.
products-stock.body: Turn on stock tracking for each product and set a low stock level. Order from suppliers with stock orders and count your shelves with stocktakes.

register-cash.title: Open and close the cash register
register-cash.summary: Count your float and close the day with confidence.
register-cash.body: Open the register with a float at the start of the day. Record cash in and out, then count and close it at the end of the day.

daily-sales.title: Reconcile your day with Daily sales
daily-sales.summary: See every transaction and cash movement for a day.
daily-sales.body: Sales > Daily sales shows the transaction summary and cash movement summary for the selected day. Export it to share with your accountant.

reports.title: Find and export reports
reports.summary: Understand sales, appointments, team and clients.
reports.body: Open Reports to browse every report by category. Filter by date, location or team member and export to CSV, Excel or PDF.

pay-runs.title: Pay your team with pay runs, wages and commissions
pay-runs.summary: Calculate wages, commissions and tips in one place.
pay-runs.body: Team > Pay runs adds up wages from timesheets, commissions and tips for each period. Review it, make adjustments and mark it as paid.

permissions.title: Control what team members can see with permissions
permissions.summary: Choose who can see reports, settings and client details.
permissions.body: Settings > Team > Permissions sets what each permission level can access. Assign a level to each team member from their profile.

wallet-payouts.title: Understand your wallet, payouts and fees
wallet-payouts.summary: How card payments reach your bank account.
wallet-payouts.body:
Card payments go to your business wallet. Payouts send the available balance to your bank account automatically, or instantly with Pay out now for a small fee.

Credits are used before fees are taken from your balance.

client-connect.title: Message clients with Client Connect
client-connect.summary: Two-way messaging with clients in one inbox.
client-connect.body: Open the inbox from the speech bubble in the top bar. Reply to client messages, use quick replies, close conversations when they are done and open the client profile from any chat.

waitlist.title: Fill gaps with the waitlist
waitlist.summary: Offer cancelled slots to clients who are waiting.
waitlist.body: Add clients to the waitlist with their preferred days and times. When a slot frees up, book them straight from the waitlist.

billing-plan.title: Change your plan and manage billing
billing-plan.body: Settings > Billing shows your plan, payment method and invoices. Change plan any time; prices exclude IVA.

account-security.title: Keep your account secure
account-security.summary: Passwords, connected logins and active sessions.
account-security.body: In Personal settings > Login & security you can change your password, connect or disconnect social logins and sign out of devices you do not recognise.

online-profile.title: Build your professional profile and portfolio
online-profile.summary: Show clients who you are and the work you do.
online-profile.body:
Add an avatar, headline, languages, interests and social links from My profile. Upload your best work to your portfolio.

Photo tips: use a bright, friendly photo of your face with a plain background.

referrals.title: Refer a business and earn credit
referrals.body: Share your referral link from the user menu. When the business starts a paid plan after its free trial, you both get €130, applied as €13 a month off your subscription.
